No registration. No extra process."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from
OpenCode Zen's **anonymo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"us free lane** — the same
models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH mode"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"l
picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode
CLI (same user agent, sam"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e correlation headers), and the model catalog stays
fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" is nothing to log into and
nothing to host."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat
- **Nati"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ve adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy G"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"o sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`)
- **CLI-identical disguise** — reques"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ts carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per convers"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ation
- **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DS"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"H's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"and no selection keeps the provider default
- **Image input where it is declared** — image attachmen"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ts are accepted for every model whose models.dev entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refu"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"sed for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified v"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ision family
- **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falli"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ng back to offline cache and a verified static list
- **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, perio"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"dic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics
- **Proper error surfaces** — upstream fa"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ilures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retrie"},{"id":"p9s15","text":" auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there):
in DSH open **Settings → P"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"lugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click
install."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**From npm**:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**From source** (build the tarball yourself):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from
the **opencode2dsh** gro"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"erify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from
the **opencode2dsh** group."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池
settings page rides the "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already
present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencod"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"e.ai` and `models.dev`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Option | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy l"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ocal-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. |
| `provid"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"erId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. |
| `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog ref"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"resh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. |
| `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may s"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"how and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blockli"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"st/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error b"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"efore any network traffic. |
| `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary."},{"id":"p22s9","text":" |
| `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. |
| `restartDelayMs` / `restartMa"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"xDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and cir"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"cuit breaker. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the
conversation's first us"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"er turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible),
and each request gets a fresh random id, mirrorin"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"g the CLI.
- **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev
pricing metadata"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list.
A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"outages.
- **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first
catalog fetch"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin
retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" settling into the periodic
refresh.
- **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local G"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"o agent (a
single-tenant port of opencode2api)
on `127.0.0.1:<random>`, token-authenticated, and reg"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"isters a standard
`llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from
`legacy/ag"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Health & troubleshooting"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- No secrets involved: the anonymous lane's key is the literal string `public`; nothing is stored, n"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"othing telemetry.
- Install paths restricted to `lib/` only; no build scripts run from dependencies."},{"id":"p32s3","text":"
- All requests go directly from your machine to `opencode.ai` / `models.dev`.
- Local OpenCode dele"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"gation (docs/delegation.md, ref #76) is **opt-in and off by default**. Enabling it makes the plugin "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"custody your opencode credential — only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root,"},{"id":"p32s6","text":" never logged, never sent anywhere but the local child — and proxy it through a managed local `openc"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"ode serve`. If upstream deems that abnormal use, your account bears the consequence. Tool execution "},{"id":"p32s8","text":"on your machine is prevented in depth (ask-then-reject + response scan + isolated env); see the doc."}],"truncated":true}
